articles.title: Agents, human agency, and the opportunity for every organization - Microsoft
articles.summary_en: Microsoft research indicates that managers play a crucial role in AI success by actively modeling its use and creating a safe environment for employees to experiment with new tools.

articles.title: Natural Language Autoencoders: Turning Claude’s thoughts into text - Anthropic
articles.summary_en: Anthropic has developed a new method called Natural Language Autoencoders that translates the internal, complex numerical thoughts of the AI model Claude into readable text to improve safety and reliability.

articles.title: Active attack: Dirty Frag Linux vulnerability expands post-compromise risk - Microsoft
articles.summary_en: Microsoft is monitoring a new Linux security vulnerability called 'Dirty Frag' that allows attackers who have gained initial access to a system to easily elevate their privileges to gain full control.

articles.title: Teaching Claude why - Anthropic
articles.summary_en: Anthropic updated its safety training methods to effectively prevent AI models from engaging in harmful, misaligned behaviors like blackmailing.

articles.title: When prompts become shells: RCE vulnerabilities in AI agent frameworks - Microsoft
articles.summary_en: Microsoft identified and fixed critical security vulnerabilities in its AI agent framework that could allow attackers to execute unauthorized code through prompt injection.

articles.title: Open by design: Ai2 brings fully open AI infrastructure online with NSF OMAI - Allen AI
articles.summary_en: The Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) has launched a new open-source infrastructure powered by NSF and NVIDIA to allow researchers to share and build upon AI experiments more efficiently.

articles.title: Advancing AI evaluation with the Center for AI Standards (US) and Innovation and the AI Security Institute (UK) - The Official Microsoft Blog
articles.summary_en: Microsoft is partnering with U.S. and U.K. government institutions to advance the science of AI testing and improve the safety and security of frontier AI models.

articles.title: Red-teaming a network of agents: Understanding what breaks when AI agents interact at scale - Microsoft
articles.summary_en: Microsoft research shows that interconnected AI agent networks face unique security risks, such as the spread of malicious data, that do not occur when agents operate in isolation.

articles.title: Claude Dreams enters research preview: What it means for AI agents - MSN
articles.summary_en: Claude Dreams has entered a research preview, marking a new step for AI agent technology.

articles.title: US to safety test new AI models from Google, Microsoft, xAI - BBC
articles.summary_en: The US government is expanding its oversight by requiring companies like Google, Microsoft, and xAI to submit new AI models for safety testing.

articles.title: Google Chrome 'silently' downloads 4GB AI model to your device without permission, report claims — researcher says practice may violate EU law, waste thousands of kilowatts of energy - Tom's Hardware
articles.summary_en: A privacy researcher claims Google Chrome is automatically downloading large AI model files to user devices without clear permission or an easy way to remove them.

articles.title: Mark and Mary Stevens give $200 million to power AI research across USC - USC Today
articles.summary_en: Mark and Mary Stevens have donated $200 million to USC to support and expand the university's research and education in computing and artificial intelligence.
